name: Mmalite Deep Learning na Neural Network
objectives: N'enweghị ndetu, ịkọwa ihe deep learning bụ na ịkpọ aha ụdị data ọ na-arụkarị ọrụ nke ọma na ya, na-ekwu maka layer na-amụta pattern site n'ọmụmaatụ na opekata mpe ụdị data abụọ dabara
Mgbe e nyere gị input, weight, bias na ReLU nke neuron, ịgbakọ ihe neuron ahụ na-enye n'aka, na-enweta azịza ziri ezi mgbe niile, gụnyere mgbe ReLU na-enye 0
Mgbe e nyere gị ndekọ ọzụzụ nwere loss na accuracy, ịkọwa otú ọzụzụ si agbanwe weight na ịmata ihe na-egosi overfitting, na-eji okwu loss, learning rate, epoch na validation n'ụzọ ziri ezi
Na Google Colab site na Keras, ibubata ọnụọgụ MNIST, ịhazi pixel ma gosi otu foto na label ya, pixel dị n'etiti 0 na 1, label ahụ dabakwara foto ahụ
Mgbe e nyere gị data MNIST a kwadebere, iwu, ịcompile na ịzụ neural network Keras, koodu ahụ na-agba, e jiri validation split, loss na-agbadakwa n'epoch niile
Mgbe e nyere gị network a zụrụ azụ, ịtụ accuracy ya na nnwale, ibu amụma foto ọhụrụ, ịnwale otu mgbanwe na ịkọwa oke ya, na-agbanwe otu ihe n'otu oge ma kpọọ opekata mpe otu ezi oke

chapters.name: Isi 1: Otú neural network si arụ ọrụ

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ihe deep learning bụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 4
Ebumnuche: Kọwaa deep learning n'okwu nke gị ma kpọọ aha ebe a na-eji ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: N'enweghị ndetu, ị ga-enwe ike ịkọwa ihe deep learning bụ na ịkpọ aha ụdị data ọ na-arụkarị ọrụ nke ọma na ya, na-ekwu maka layer na-amụta pattern site n'ọmụmaatụ na opekata mpe ụdị data abụọ dabara.
Deep learning bụ ụdị machine learning na-eji neural network: ọtụtụ obere ngwa mgbakọ, a na-akpọ neuron, ejikọtara n'ọtụtụ layer. "Deep" (miri emi) pụtara na e nwere ọtụtụ layer. Layer ọ bụla na-achọta pattern n'ihe layer bu ya ụzọ wepụtara.
Maka foto, layer mbụ na-ahụ ihe dị mfe dị ka nsọtụ, layer etiti na-ahụ ọdịdị, layer ndị ikpeazụ na-ahụ ihe zuru ezu dị ka ihu mmadụ ma ọ bụ ọnụọgụ. Ọ dịghị onye na-ede iwu ndị ahụ: network ahụ na-amụta ha site n'ọtụtụ ọmụmaatụ nwere label.
Ọ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma mgbe data dị ukwuu, data ahụ gbagwojuru anya ma baa ọgaranya: foto, ụda, okwu ọnụ na ederede ogologo. Ọ chọrọ data na ike kọmputa karịa model ndị dị mfe, ọ bụ ya mere o ji bilie mgbe nnukwu dataset na mgbawa eserese ngwa ngwa (GPU) bịara juputa.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Deep learning: machine learning na-eji neural network nwere ọtụtụ layer.
- Neural network: model e ji ọtụtụ obere ngwa (neuron) ejikọtara na layer mee.
- Layer: otu ìgwè neuron na-anata input site na layer bu ya ụzọ.
- GPU: mgbawa eserese (graphics chip) na-eme ọtụtụ mgbakọ n'otu oge, e ji azụ network ngwa ngwa.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee ngwa anọ i jirila nke nwere ike iji deep learning (dịka ọmụmaatụ imeghe ekwentị site n'ihu, ide ihe site n'olu, ịchọ foto, ntụgharị asụsụ). Maka nke ọ bụla, dee ụdị data ọ na-amụta na ya: foto, ụda ma ọ bụ ederede.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkọwa ihe deep learning bụ, ihe mere o ji eji layer, na ebe a na-eji ya.

check.q: Gịnị bụ neuron na neural network?
options: Mkpụrụ ndụ ụbụrụ e detuuru na kọmputa
Obere ngwa mgbakọ ejikọtara na layer
check.why: E ji ọtụtụ obere ngwa mgbakọ, a na-akpọ neuron, n'ime layer mee neural network.

check.q: Ndị otu gị chọrọ ịhazi puku kwuru puku ozi redio e dekọrọ site n'onye na-ekwu okwu. Ị ga-atụle deep learning?
options: Ee; ọ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'ọtụtụ data bara ọgaranya dị ka ụda
Mba; deep learning enweghị ike iji ụda
Mba; ọ na-arụ naanị n'ọnụọgụ dị na tebụl
Naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ndekọ ahụ erughị iri
check.why: Deep learning na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'ọtụtụ data bara ọgaranya, gbagwojuru anya, dị ka foto, ụda na ederede.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: N'ime neuron: weight, bias na activation
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Gbakọọ n'aka ihe otu neuron na-enye.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị input, weight, bias na ReLU nke neuron, ị ga-enwe ike ịgbakọ ihe neuron ahụ na-enye n'aka, na-enweta azịza ziri ezi mgbe niile, gụnyere mgbe ReLU na-enye 0.
Neuron na-anata ọnụọgụ ụfọdụ, na-amụba nke ọ bụla site na weight, na-agbakọta ha, ma gbakwunye otu ọnụọgụ ọzọ a na-akpọ bias. Weight na-egosi otú input ọ bụla si dị mkpa; network ahụ na-amụta ha.
Mgbe ahụ ọ na-eji activation function, nke na-ekpebi ihe ọ ga-ebufe. Nke a na-ejikarị, ReLU, dị mfe: ọ bụrụ na nchikota ahụ erughị efu, nye 0; ma ọ bụghị ya, nye nchikota ahụ.
Ọmụmaatụ: input 2 na 3, weight 0.5 na -1, bias 1. Nchikota = 2 x 0.5 + 3 x (-1) + 1 = 1 - 3 + 1 = -1. ReLU na-eme -1 ka ọ bụrụ 0, ya mere neuron a na-enye 0. Ọ bụrụ input 2 na 1 kama: 1 - 1 + 1 = 1, ya mere ọ na-enye 1.
Network nwere puku kwuru puku n'ime ndị a. Layer ikpeazụ na-ejikarị softmax, nke na-eme ka ihe ọ na-enye ghọọ ohere (chances) gbakọtara ruo pasent 100, otu maka azịza ọ bụla nwere ike ịbụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Mụbaa input ọ bụla site na weight ya.
- Gbakọta nsonaazụ ha.
- Gbakwunye bias.
- Tinye activation: na ReLU, ihe na-erughị efu na-aghọ 0.
- Ọnụọgụ ahụ bụ ihe neuron ahụ na-enye.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Neuron: obere ngwa na-amụba input site na weight, na-agbakwunye bias ma na-eji activation.
- Weight: ọnụọgụ network na-amụta nke na-egosi otú input si dị mkpa.
- Bias: ọnụọgụ ọzọ a gbakwunyere na nchikota, a na-amụtakwa ya.
- Activation function: iwu na-ekpebi ihe neuron na-ebufe.
- ReLU: otu activation: nchikota na-erughị efu na-aghọ 0, ndị ọzọ na-anọ otu ha dị.
- Softmax: na-eme ka ihe layer ikpeazụ na-enye ghọọ ohere gbakọtara ruo 1.
Nwaa ugbu a: Gbakọọ n'aka ihe neuron na-enye: input 4 na 1, weight 0.5 na 2, bias -3, activation ReLU. Wee gbanwee bias ka ọ bụrụ -6 ma gbakọọ ya ọzọ. (Azịza: 1, wee 0.)
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịgbakọ ihe neuron na-enye site na input, weight, bias na activation ya.

options: Iwu na-ekwu na model ahụ ezighi ezi
Otu ọnụọgụ ọzọ a gbakwunyere mgbe a gbakọtachara input na weight ha
check.why: Neuron na-agbakwunye bias na nchikota weight tupu activation.

check.q: Input 4 na 1, weight 0.5 na 2, bias -1, ReLU. Gịnị ka ị ga-agbakọ dị ka ihe ọ na-enye?
check.why: 4 x 0.5 + 1 x 2 - 1 = 3, ReLU na-edebekwa nchikota karịrị efu.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Otú network si amụta ihe: loss, epoch na obere nzọụkwụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kọwaa otú ọzụzụ si agbanwe weight iji belata mperi.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ndekọ ọzụzụ nwere loss na accuracy, ị ga-enwe ike ịkọwa otú ọzụzụ si agbanwe weight na ịmata ihe na-egosi overfitting, na-eji okwu loss, learning rate, epoch na validation n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
Na mbido, weight bụ nke a họrọ n'enweghị usoro (random), ya mere ihe network na-eche adịghị mma. Ọzụzụ na-edozi nke ahụ. Network na-eche otu azịza, loss function na-atụkwa otú o si mehie: loss buru ibu pụtara na o mehiere nke ukwuu, obere loss pụtara na ọ dị nso.
Mgbe ahụ ọ na-achọpụta, maka weight ọ bụla, ụzọ ga-ebelata loss (a na-akpọ nzọụkwụ a backpropagation) ma na-akwali weight ọ bụla obere nzọụkwụ n'ụzọ ahụ (gradient descent). Ogo nzọụkwụ ahụ bụ learning rate: ọ buru oke ibu, ọ na-agafe; ọ dị oke nta, ọ na-adị nwayọọ nke ukwuu.
Otu ngagharị n'ọmụmaatụ ọzụzụ niile bụ epoch. Ọzụzụ na-ewekarị ọtụtụ epoch. Ị na-ele ka loss na-agbada, accuracy na-arịgo, ị na-elelekwa validation set (data a debere n'akụkụ, a naghị eji ya azụ) iji jide overfitting: ọ bụrụ na accuracy ọzụzụ na-arịgo mana accuracy validation na-agbada, kwụsị.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Malite na weight a họrọ n'enweghị usoro.
- Chee azịza n'ọmụmaatụ ọzụzụ.
- Tụọ mperi ahụ site na loss function.
- Kwalie weight ọ bụla obere nzọụkwụ iji belata loss.
- Mee ya ọzọ ruo ọtụtụ epoch, na-ele accuracy validation.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Loss: ọnụọgụ na-atụ otú ihe network chere si mehie.
- Backpropagation: ịchọpụta otú weight ọ bụla si metụta loss.
- Gradient descent: ịkwali weight n'obere nzọụkwụ iji belata loss.
- Learning rate: otú nzọụkwụ ọ bụla si buo ibu.
- Epoch: otu ngagharị zuru ezu na data ọzụzụ.
- Validation set: data a debere n'akụkụ n'oge ọzụzụ iji lelee overfitting.
Nwaa ugbu a: Gwuo egwuregwu "chee ọnụọgụ" gị na enyi gị ma ọ bụ naanị gị: họrọ ọnụọgụ zoro ezo site na 1 ruo 100, chee, nweta "ọ karịrị" ma ọ bụ "o rughị", ma gbanwee ihe i chere site n'obere nzọụkwụ kwa oge. Dee akụkụ egwuregwu ahụ yiri loss, nke yiri learning rate, na ole agba (epoch) o were.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkọwa loss, backpropagation, gradient descent, learning rate, epoch na overfitting n'okwu dị mfe.

options: Ogo nzọụkwụ ọ bụla weight na-aga
check.why: Nzọụkwụ buru oke ibu na-agafe; nzọụkwụ dị oke nta na-adị nwayọọ nke ukwuu.

check.q: Mgbe epoch 4 gachara, accuracy validation malitere ịgbada ebe accuracy ọzụzụ na-arịgo. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Kwụsị ọzụzụ; model ahụ amalitela overfitting
check.why: Accuracy validation na-agbada ebe accuracy ọzụzụ na-arịgo bụ ihe na-egosi overfitting.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Iwu neural network na Colab

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Ibubata na ịkwadebe data foto
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Bubata ọnụọgụ MNIST na Colab, hazie ha, ma lee otu foto.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Na Google Colab site na Keras, ị ga-enwe ike ibubata ọnụọgụ MNIST, ịhazi pixel ma gosi otu foto na label ya, pixel dị n'etiti 0 na 1, label ahụ dabakwara foto ahụ.
MNIST bụ dataset omume a ma ama: 70,000 obere foto nke ọnụọgụ 0 ruo 9 e ji aka dee, nke ọ bụla 28 na 28 pixel, ọnụọgụ ziri ezi bụkwa label ya. Keras, ọba akwụkwọ deep learning n'efu na-arụ ọrụ na Google Colab, nwere ike ibubata ya n'otu ahịrị, nke e kewaworị ka ọ bụrụ 60,000 foto ọzụzụ na 10,000 foto nnwale.
Pixel ọ bụla bụ ọnụọgụ site na 0 (oji) ruo 255 (ọcha). Network na-amụta nke ọma karịa site n'obere ọnụọgụ, ya mere ị na-ahazi ha ka ha dị n'etiti 0 na 1 site n'ike ha na 255. A na-akpọ nke a normalizing.
Lee data gị tupu ọzụzụ. matplotlib, ọba akwụkwọ maka ise eserese, nwere ike ise otu foto ka ị hụ ma label ahụ dabara foto ahụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Na notebook Colab ọhụrụ, gbaa: import keras
- Bubata: (x_train, y_train), (x_test, y_test) = keras.datasets.mnist.load_data()
- Hazie: x_train = x_train / 255.0 na x_test = x_test / 255.0
- Lelee ogo: print(x_train.shape, x_test.shape)
- See otu: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.imshow(x_train[0], cmap="gray"); plt.show(); print(y_train[0])
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- MNIST: dataset omume nwere 70,000 foto ọnụọgụ e ji aka dee.
- Keras: ọba akwụkwọ Python n'efu, dị mfe maka ndị mbido, e ji ewu neural network.
- Pixel: otu ntụpọ nke foto, e debere dị ka ọnụọgụ.
- Normalizing: ịhazi ọnụọgụ ka ha dị n'obere oke dị ka 0 ruo 1 ka ọzụzụ rụọ ọrụ nke ọma.
- matplotlib: ọba akwụkwọ Python maka ise chaatị na foto.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Ọmụmaatụ koodu Keras: Simple MNIST convnet
- Google Colab: Ajụjụ a na-ajụkarị
Nwaa ugbu a: Bubata ma hazie MNIST na Colab. Bipụta ogo (shape) nke set ọzụzụ na set nnwale. See foto ndị dị n'ọnọdụ 0, 1 na 2 ma bipụta label ha ka ị hụ ma ha dabara.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ibubata dataset foto, ịnormalize ya na ilele ya n'anya.

check.q: Gịnị ka ịnormalize pixel MNIST pụtara ebe a?
options: Ịhazi ha ka ha dị n'etiti 0 na 1 site n'ike ha na 255
Ịtụgharị foto ndị ahụ isi ala
Ime ka foto ọ bụla bụrụ ọnụọgụ 0
check.why: Ike ya na 255 na-eme ka 0 ruo 255 ghọọ 0 ruo 1, nke na-enyere mmụta aka.

check.q: I bubatara MNIST ma chọọ ijide n'aka na label ndị ahụ ziri ezi. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Zụọ mbụ, lelee mgbe e mesịrị
See otu foto site na matplotlib ma lelee na ọ dabara label ya
check.why: Lee data gị tupu ọzụzụ ka ị hụ na label ahụ dabara foto ahụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Iwu na ịzụ network ahụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Wuo network Keras, compile ya ma zụọ ya ruo epoch ole na ole.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị data MNIST a kwadebere, ị ga-enwe ike iwu, ịcompile na ịzụ neural network Keras, koodu ahụ na-agba, e jiri validation split, loss na-agbadakwa n'epoch niile.
Sequential model bụ layer ndị a tụkọbara n'elu ibe ha. Nke anyị: keras.Input(shape=(28, 28)) na-ekwu ihe na-abanye. layers.Flatten() na-eme ka foto 28 x 28 ọ bụla ghọọ otu ahịrị nke ọnụọgụ 784. layers.Dense(128, activation="relu") bụ layer nwere neuron 128. layers.Dense(10, activation="softmax") bụ ihe na-apụta: otu ohere maka ọnụọgụ ọ bụla site na 0 ruo 9.
compile na-ekpebi otú ọ ga-esi mụta: optimizer="adam" (ụdị gradient descent a ma ama), loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy" (loss ziri ezi mgbe label bụ ọnụọgụ nkịtị dị ka 7), na metrics=["accuracy"] ka ị hụ ugboro ole o ziri ezi.
fit na-azụ ya: model.fit(x_train, y_train, epochs=5, validation_split=0.1). validation_split=0.1 na-edebe pasent 10 nke data ọzụzụ n'akụkụ iji lelee overfitting. Epoch ọ bụla na-ebipụta loss, accuracy, val_loss na val_accuracy. Lee ka loss na-agbada.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- from keras import layers
- model = keras.Sequential([keras.Input(shape=(28, 28)), layers.Flatten(), layers.Dense(128, activation="relu"), layers.Dense(10, activation="softmax")])
- model.compile(optimizer="adam", loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy", metrics=["accuracy"])
- model.summary() ka ị hụ layer ndị ahụ.
- model.fit(x_train, y_train, epochs=5, validation_split=0.1)
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Sequential model: network e ji layer a tụkọbara n'usoro, otu n'azụ ibe ya, mee.
- Flatten: layer na-eme ka grid pixel ghọọ otu ahịrị ogologo.
- Dense layer: layer ebe neuron ọ bụla jikọrọ na input ọ bụla.
- Optimizer: ụzọ e ji emeghari weight; adam bụ nke a na-ejikarị.
- compile: na-ekpebi optimizer, loss na metrics tupu ọzụzụ.
- validation_split: òkè data ọzụzụ a debere n'akụkụ iji lelee overfitting.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Ọmụmaatụ koodu Keras: Simple MNIST convnet
Nwaa ugbu a: Wuo, compile ma zụọ network ahụ ruo epoch 5. Dee accuracy na val_accuracy mgbe epoch 1 gachara na mgbe epoch 5 gachara. Ha abụọ ọ rịgoro?
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iwu neural network na Keras, ịcompile ya na ịzụ ya ka ị na-ele maka overfitting.

check.q: Gịnị bụ Sequential model na Keras?
options: Layer a tụkọbara, otu n'azụ ibe ya
check.why: Sequential na-atụkọba layer n'usoro site na input ruo output.

check.q: Ị chọrọ ịhụ n'oge ọzụzụ ma model ahụ amalitela overfitting. Gịnị ka ị ga-agbakwunye na fit?
check.why: validation_split na-edebe ụfọdụ data ọzụzụ n'akụkụ iji lelee model ahụ kwa epoch.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Ịnwale, ibu amụma na ime ka ọ ka mma
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Tụọ accuracy nnwale, buo amụma ezi foto, nwaa otu mgbanwe ma kpọọ aha oke model ahụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị network a zụrụ azụ, ị ga-enwe ike ịtụ accuracy ya na nnwale, ibu amụma foto ọhụrụ, ịnwale otu mgbanwe na ịkọwa oke ya, na-agbanwe otu ihe n'otu oge ma kpọọ opekata mpe otu ezi oke.
Ezi nnwale bụ data network ahụ na-ahụbeghị: model.evaluate(x_test, y_test) na-ebipụta loss na accuracy nnwale. Obere network dị ka nke anyị na-enwetakarị ihe karịrị pasent 90 nke ọma na MNIST.
Iji buo amụma, nye ya foto: probs = model.predict(x_test[:5]) na-enye ohere 10 maka foto ọ bụla. probs.argmax(axis=1) na-ahọrọ ọnụọgụ nwere ohere kachasị elu. Tụnyere ndị ahụ na y_test[:5].
Iji mee ka ọ ka mma, gbanwee otu ihe n'otu oge ma nwalee ọzọ: neuron ndị ọzọ (Dense(256)), epoch ndị ọzọ, ma ọ bụ convolutional network (layer na-enyocha obere akụkụ nke foto), nke na-eru ihe dị ka pasent 99 n'ọmụmaatụ Keras gọọmentị.
Mara oke ya: ọ maara naanị otu ọnụọgụ dị n'etiti dị ka MNIST. Foto akara okporo ụzọ ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ akwụkwọ ga-enwetakwa ọnụọgụ. N'ezi ọrụ, dị ka ịgụ fọm ma ọ bụ inyocha akụkụ ngwaahịa, mmadụ na-elele nsonaazụ ndị model ahụ na-ejighị n'aka, a na-anwalekwa model ahụ na data sitere n'ezi ebe a ga-eji ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Gbaa model.evaluate(x_test, y_test) ma dee accuracy nnwale.
- probs = model.predict(x_test[:5])
- print(probs.argmax(axis=1), y_test[:5]) iji tụnyere ihe o chere na eziokwu.
- Gbanwee otu ihe (neuron ma ọ bụ epoch), wughachi, zụghachi ma nwalee ọzọ.
- Dee ma ọ nyere aka na otu oke.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- evaluate: na-anwale model a zụrụ azụ na data ma na-ekwu loss na accuracy.
- argmax: na-ahọrọ ọnọdụ ọnụọgụ kachasị ukwuu: ebe a, ọnụọgụ kachasị nwee ike ịbụ.
- Convolutional network (CNN): network nwere layer na-enyocha obere akụkụ nke foto; ọ maara foto nke ọma.
- Hyperparameter: ntọala ị na-ahọrọ, dị ka neuron ma ọ bụ epoch, ọ bụghị nke network na-amụta.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Ọmụmaatụ koodu Keras: Simple MNIST convnet
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: nwalee network gị na set nnwale, buo amụma foto nnwale ise mbụ ma tụnyere ha na ezi label ha, wee gbanwee Dense(128) ka ọ bụrụ Dense(256) ma ọ bụ epoch ka ọ bụrụ 10, zụghachi ma nwalee ọzọ. Dee ahịrịokwu abụọ: mgbanwe ahụ ọ nyere aka, gịnị bụkwa otu oke model a nwere?
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịzụ, ịnwale, iji na ime ka neural network ka mma, na ịkọwa ebe a ga-atụkwasị ya obi na ebe a na-agaghị atụkwasị ya obi.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Data a kwadebere E bubataghị MNIST ma ọ bụ a hazighị pixel ndị ahụ. E bubatara MNIST, a hazikwara pixel ka ha dị n'etiti 0 na 1. E sere otu foto ma lelee ya na label ya. E wuru ma zụọ network Model ahụ anaghị compile ma ọ bụ azụ. Network Keras nwere Flatten, Dense layer zoro ezo na output softmax nwere neuron 10 na-azụ site na validation split. Na-edekọ otú loss na accuracy validation si gbanwee n'epoch niile. Accuracy nnwale na amụma Enweghị accuracy nnwale, ma ọ bụ a tụnyereghị amụma na ezi label. Na-ekwu accuracy nnwale ma tụnyere amụma ise na ezi label ha. Na-elekwa otu amụma ezighi ezi ma kwuo ihe nwere ike ịkpata ya. E nwalere otu mgbanwe E meghị mgbanwe ọ bụla, ma ọ bụ a gbanwere ọtụtụ ihe n'otu oge. Otu mgbanwe (neuron ndị ọzọ ma ọ bụ epoch ndị ọzọ), a zụghachiri ya, ya na ahịrịokwu maka ma ọ nyere aka. Na-elelekwa mgbanwe ahụ maka ihe na-egosi overfitting. Oke A kpọghị aha oke ọ bụla, ma ọ bụ oke ahụ ezighi ezi. Otu ezi oke, dị ka ịmara naanị otu ọnụọgụ dị n'etiti. Na-ekwukwa otú mmadụ ga-esi lelee nsonaazụ ọ na-ejighị n'aka n'ezi ọrụ. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.
